text:
ara: Heads-up — PraxisHealth is reporting 503s on /embeddings when prefix cache invalidates. Saw spike at ~09:12 UTC. SLA alert triggered.
sam: On it. Is this same stack change we rolled yesterday (kv-cache refactor)?
jordan: yes, that rollout bumped eviction timing. I flagged a possible race in inflight invalidation. Repro locally with high qps and concurrent invalidates.
maria: Customer is on Dedicated, so we need a short-term mitigation before we push a code patch. ETA on workaround?
ara: Can we temporarily increase prefix cache TTL to reduce invalidations? If we set to 10m it should smooth traffic.
sam: I can patch the config in prod for PraxisHealth only (routing tag). Plan: set cache.ttl_ms = 600000 for their pool and enable strict KV lock.
jordan: I'll prepare a small PR for the real fix (guard inflight invalidation with per-key refcount). PR: <https://git.company/repo/pulls/2987|#2987> — needs review from @maria and @sam.
maria: Reviewing now. If we do the config change first, can we schedule a rollback window? We need cutover plan and monitor.
deploy-bot: Scheduled config update for pool praxis-health at 09:25 UTC. CI checks passed.
ara: Monitoring after config change — initial traffic looks stable. No 5xx in last 3 min.
sam: I'll keep the config in place for 2 hours, then try a controlled redeploy with the PR. If anything spikes, restore old TTL immediately.
jordan: PR updated with tests. tagging @maria for final signoff.
maria: LGTM, merge on green. @sam coordinate the redeploy and notify support.
ara: Notifying customer that we applied temporary mitigation and will follow-up with permanent fix and timeline.
sam: After merge I'll roll the change to a single node canary then full pool. ETA finish by 11:00 UTC.
ara: Thanks all. Logging action items: 1) sam — config patch & monitor; 2) jordan — PR + tests; 3) maria — review + signoff; 4) ara — customer comms. Will close thread when clean.
